translations.title: Polysaccharide Iron Complex 326.1 mg Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for iron deficiency anaemia.
translations.usage: Adults take one capsule (150 mg as iron) once a day. Avoid green tea, black tea, milk and dairy products just before and after taking it.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, for a baby under 12 months, or if you have haemochromatosis, chronic pancreatitis, liver cirrhosis, anaemia that is not caused by iron deficiency, or a problem using iron. If a child takes too much, iron poisoning can be fatal — always keep it out of the reach of children. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you have a peptic ulcer or kidney problems, and do not take it together with an antacid, tetracycline or a calcium supplement.
